Como quieres decidir entre reagendar o cancelar una reserva ya hecha, te paso con el equipo para que te explique el proceso según tu caso.

msg: Anything needs to be completed beforehand? I’m gonna need a little refresher.
reply:
Absolutely! If it’s been more than two years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required. From Cartagena, it’s booked as the Dive Mini Course and includes pool practice plus one ocean dive with an instructor.

Beforehand, you’ll need to complete the medical form and the theory sent by email after booking. The insurance form and certified-diver waiver are also completed before the activity. You can book here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

A refresher and a certified diver can go together on the same outing.

Are you departing from Cartagena, or will you already be staying on the Rosario Islands?
